info.name: BloodBridge Frontend API
info.description:
Postman collection mirroring **every API call the BloodBridge React frontend actually makes** (source: `Frontend/src/services/*.jsx`).

## Folder ↔ Service ↔ Page mapping
| Folder | Service file | Used by pages |
|---|---|---|
| 01 Auth | authApi.jsx | Login.jsx, Register.jsx |
| 02 Public NGO Directory | publicNgoApi.js | LandingPage.jsx |
| 03 Organization Registration | organizationApi.jsx | OrganizationRegistration.jsx, RegistrationStatus.jsx |
| 04 SuperAdmin Auth & Dashboard | superadminApi.jsx | superadmin/*.jsx |
| 05 NGO Portal | ngoApi.jsx | ngo/CampManagement.jsx, ngo/SlotManagement.jsx, ngo/DonorRegistry.jsx, ngo/NgoDashboard.jsx |
| 06 Hospital | hospitalApi.jsx | hospital/Overview.jsx, hospital/Profile.jsx, hospital/AdminVerification.jsx |
| 07 Hospital Blood Requests | hospitalBloodRequestApi.jsx | hospital/BloodRequests.jsx, components/CreateBloodRequestModal.jsx |
| 08 Hospital NGO Drives | hospitalNgoDriveApi.jsx | hospital/NgoDrives.jsx |
| 09 Blood Bank Portal | bloodBankApi.jsx | bloodbank/*.jsx |

## How to use
1. Start backend on `http://localhost:5000` (frontend runs on `http://localhost:5173`).
2. Run a login request first — tokens auto-save:
   - `POST /api/auth/login` → `{{token}}` (NGO/Hospital/BloodBank org users + regular users)
   - `POST /api/admin/auth/login` → `{{adminToken}}`
   - `POST /api/superadmin/auth/login` → `{{superAdminToken}}`
3. Replace sample ids (`{{hospitalId}}`, `{{campId}}`, ...) with real MongoDB ids.

> Note: a few Blood Bank Portal calls (e.g. `PATCH /admin/requests/:id/status`) exist in the frontend service but have **no matching backend route** — they are included here so you can see the mismatch while testing.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Source: `Frontend/src/services/authApi.jsx` → used by `Login.jsx` and `Register.jsx`. Login auto-saves `{{token}}`.

request.description: `loginUser(data)` — org users include `organizationCode`; regular users omit it. Frontend stores token in `localStorage.token`.

item.name: 09 Blood Bank Portal
item.description:
Source: `Frontend/src/services/bloodBankApi.jsx` → used by `bloodbank/DashboardOverview.jsx`, `BloodStock.jsx`, `NgoDrives.jsx`, `HospitalRequests.jsx`, `ProfileSettings.jsx`, `AdminMessages.jsx`. Uses axios instance with `localStorage.token` interceptor. Login as a blood-bank org user first (saves `{{token}}`).

> ⚠️ `PATCH /admin/requests/:id/status`, `PATCH /admin/drives/:id/status` and `/admin/dashboard/stats|activities` are called by the frontend but **may not exist** on the backend — included so you can verify the mismatch.

request.description: ⚠️ Backend route is `/admin/drives/id/:id` — this frontend path relies on `/id/:id`; verify while testing.
⚠️ No matching backend PUT route — verify.
